title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs — Manufacturer Copay Card Carry-Forward When Expiration Is Near
content:
For a Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs, the whole months from the last day of the closing period to the program's expiration date finally set the part of the carry-forward kept, the carry-forward here being the amount after the length of the closing period has been applied:

- **3 to 5 months** keep half of it (50 percent), rounded to the cent half up;
- **fewer than 3 months** keep none of it;
- **6 months or more** keep all of it.

The expiration date is the one the card enrollment shows.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical carry-forward of $367.50)

| Whole months from the period's last day to the expiration date | Part kept | Amount kept |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | none | $0.00 |
| 3 | half | $183.75 |
| 5 | half | $183.75 |
| 6 | all | $367.50 |
